candidate.title: Piecewise polynomiality and degree of labelled twisted double Hurwitz numbers in resonance chambers
candidate.author: Hahn, Marvin Anas; Markwig, Hannah
candidate.difficulty_reason: The author passes to involution-quotient monodromy graphs, chooses independent cycle-flow variables and sums weighted lattice points under positivity constraints. The quotient-genus calculation and Faulhaber degree tracking give the twisted degree formula; the ordinary double-Hurwitz chamber theorem is an explicit cited prerequisite, while labelled parts and the repeated-part automorphism correction are retained.
